cost.description: The cost it was bought for.

examples: Elect a method on the asset: section 19, 19A(1), 19A(2) or 19A(10A)

reason.description: Why it is listed apart: no_election, the company has not elected a method; before_pack, acquired in a basis period before YA 2023; disposed, a disposal of part of the asset stands, or of one whose proceeds are not known, and its balancing allowance or charge is the tax agent's; over_cap, elected under section 19A(10A) but over S$5,000 or past the year's S$30,000; bad_life, a working life the prescribed life does not allow; not_sgd, the base currency is not Singapore dollars.
